displayName: Foundry accounts should enable trusted-service network access
description: Audit project-enabled AIServices accounts unless networkAcls.bypass is AzureServices and public access is disabled or uses a default-deny firewall. Preserves selected-network access without an IP allowlist parameter. Does not validate individual IP/subnet approvals, actual connectivity, or change firewall settings. Audit is the default.

builtInReview.gap: No Cognitive Services built-in inspecting networkAcls.bypass was found among 2862 live built-ins. Network restriction and public-network-disable built-ins do not require the trusted-service exception.

metadata.description: Audit reports the missing trusted-service exception. Deny is available only for a separate explicit assignment.
